precepts.text: One shall call himself by the name of Jacob, and another surname himself by the name of Israel; the name tells whose people you are.
precepts.point: Reading these family names aloud loosens the tongue to say the names of the scriptures fluently and without hesitation. 1 Chronicles 1 serves the same practice, and it carries the names of Israel's families together with Edom and Ishmael, the nations that come out of Abraham's line.

note.label: Numbers 26: The Second Census of the Families of Israel

precepts.why:
“Hanoch, of whom cometh the family of the Hanochites: of Pallu, the family of the Palluites.” The ending ites means the descendants of, the people you belong to: Israelites are the descendants of Israel, Edomites the descendants of Edom, and so it goes all down the line through the scriptures.

“One shall say, I am the Lord’s; and another shall call himself by the name of Jacob; and another shall subscribe with his hand unto the Lord, and surname himself by the name of Israel.” The name tells whose people you are: one calls himself by the name of Jacob, another surnames himself by the name of Israel, as the Hanochites carried the name of Hanoch.

Reading these family names aloud loosens the tongue to say the names of the scriptures fluently and without hesitation. 1 Chronicles 1 serves the same practice, and it carries the names of Israel's families together with Edom and Ishmael, the nations that come out of Abraham's line.

precepts.text: Nadab and Abihu offered strange fire before the Lord, which he commanded them not, and fire from the Lord devoured them.
precepts.point: Nadab and Abihu died when they offered strange fire before the Lord; go back and read that account.

note.label: Numbers 26: The Second Census of the Families of Israel

precepts.why:
“And Nadab and Abihu died, when they offered strange fire before the Lord.” Go back and read that account.

“And Nadab and Abihu, the sons of Aaron, took either of them his censer, and put fire therein, and put incense thereon, and offered strange fire before the Lord, which he commanded them not. And there went out fire from the Lord, and devoured them, and they died before the Lord.”

They offered strange fire which He commanded them not, and fire from the Lord devoured them. That is why the census names only Eleazar and Ithamar of Aaron's sons still standing.

precepts.text: None that provoked the Lord shall see the land, but Caleb, because he had another spirit with him and followed the Lord fully, shall possess it.
precepts.point: Let that be a lesson learned, for whatsoever things were written aforetime were written for our learning, that we through patience and comfort of the scriptures might have hope.

note.label: Numbers 26: The Second Census of the Families of Israel

precepts.why:
Of all the men numbered in the wilderness of Sinai, “there was not left a man of them, save Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.” Why Caleb and Joshua? They had another spirit on them and did not doubt when the Lord sent them to spy out the land.

“Surely they shall not see the land which I sware unto their fathers, neither shall any of them that provoked me see it: But my servant Caleb, because he had another spirit with him, and hath followed me fully, him will I bring into the land whereinto he went; and his seed shall possess it.”

None that provoked the Lord saw the land; Caleb, because he had another spirit with him and followed the Lord fully, went in and his seed possessed it. He let nobody keep him from serving the Most High.

precepts.text: He that loveth father or mother more than Christ is not worthy of him; nothing may keep you from following fully.
precepts.point: Let that be a lesson learned, for whatsoever things were written aforetime were written for our learning, that we through patience and comfort of the scriptures might have hope.

note.label: Numbers 26: The Second Census of the Families of Israel

precepts.why:
Caleb followed the Lord fully, and Christ said the same thing: “He that loveth father or mother more than me is not worthy of me: and he that loveth son or daughter more than me is not worthy of me.”

If the Lord finds you lukewarm, choosing your kids, your parents, or your spouse over following God and Christ and keeping the commandments wholly, you will not enter into the land, as that whole generation did not. You must follow fully like Caleb and zealously like Phinehas; nothing may keep you from following fully.

note.label: Numbers 26: The Second Census of the Families of Israel

precepts.why:
A whole generation numbered at Sinai fell in the wilderness, and only Caleb and Joshua were left. Let that be a lesson learned.

“For whatsoever things were written aforetime were written for our learning, that we through patience and comfort of the scriptures might have hope.” The second census was written for our learning: follow fully like Caleb and zealously like Phinehas, and through patience and comfort of the scriptures have hope of entering the land.

points: After the plague the Lord commanded a new numbering of the congregation, from twenty years old and upward, all that are able to go to war in Israel. Twenty is the biblical age of a man: Israel sent men to war, not children, so the numbering of them able for war fixes the age of manhood at twenty years old.

points: Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan, and the families of Judah continued through Shelah, Pharez, and Zerah, threescore and sixteen thousand and five hundred numbered.

note.label: Numbers 26: The Second Census of the Families of Israel

points: The numbered of the children of Israel were six hundred thousand and a thousand seven hundred and thirty. Unto these the land shall be divided for an inheritance according to the number of names: to many the more inheritance, to few the less, and the land divided by lot according to the tribes of their fathers.

points: Land is how wealth is built, and Esau knows how important land is; that is why the land is kept in his generations and why Gad, the Native Indian, was never given one square inch of his land back, only the casinos and the little plots called reservations. Israel is getting the most fertile land back; as for this land here, let it burn.
